title: MSFS 2024 Saab 340 Landing & Descent Tutorial (Mastery Finale)
description:
The Saab 340 landing and descent in MSFS 2024 requires precise energy management—unless you follow a disciplined real-world workflow. In this final episode, you’ll learn the complete Saab 340 descent planning, VREF calculation, landing technique, and shutdown so you can finish your flights like a pro.

In this episode of our Saab 340 masterclass, we go sky-to-ramp step-by-step: 3:1 descent math, IAS vs. VS autopilot modes, using condition levers for drag, and the legendary beta range. This is the “professional rhythm” and technical discipline that separates button-pushing from real turboprop flying.

What You’ll Learn in This Episode:

- Energy Management: Using the 3:1 rule and IAS mode for a stabilized descent.
- Drag Tactics: Moving condition levers to MAX to act as a massive speed brake.
- Landing Physics: Managing Flaps 35 and the 106kt VREF for a "greaser" touchdown.
- Beta Range: How to use the Saab 340's unique prop range for short-field performance.
- Complete Shutdown: Gust locks, avionics cooling, and battery preservation.

📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Final Episode: Saab 340 Descent & Landing
1:09 - "The arrival brief": EFB Setup & VREF
2:48 - Autopilot: VS mode and IAS
5:12 - The 3:1 rule and energy management
6:16 - The final approach: configuration & stabilized criteria
12:20 - Touchdown without the beta range
14:13 - The final mile: shutdown procedure
16:48 - The end and which aircraft is next?
